relationships.subject: TLR4-lipid rafts
relationships.evidence_quote: co-localization of TRPV1 with TLR4 to cholesterol-rich lipid membrane rafts in nociceptors is essential for its normal activation as well as for its exaggerated activation that underlies the development and expression of CIPN

key_findings: TRPV1 activation in DRG nociceptors depends on co-localization with TLR4 in lipid rafts; AIBP disrupts these rafts.
